{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Casts of {c_important}Landslide{/c} leave behind Tectonic Spikes that deal {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

Spawning a {c_important}Landslide{/c} pillar within Tectonic Spikes has a {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_2 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to spawn two instead.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
